meta.title: 遮法令纹跟练｜范围、手法 新手一次性看懂
meta.title_en: Concealing Nasolabial Folds — Area & Technique for Beginners

scenes.title_cn: 开场：有纹没纹，脸一下子年轻10岁。…
scenes.title_en: Opening: with or without the folds, the fa…
scenes.context: 范围错或太厚都是常见坑。
sentences: 有纹没纹，脸一下子年轻10岁。
With or without the folds, the face looks ten years younger.
ten years younger（年轻10岁）
要么范围不对遮了跟没遮一个样，要么厚厚一坨全卡在鼻翼两侧。
Either you miss the area or pile on a blob that cakes at the nose wings.
cake at the nose（卡鼻翼）
从原理到手法再到工具，一次讲清楚这种凹凸结合的立体结构。
Principle to technique to tools, in one pass for this raised-and-recessed structure.
raised-and-recessed（凹凸结合）
scenes.speak: With or without the folds, the face looks ten years younger. Either you miss the area or pile on a blob that cakes at the nose wings. Principle to technique to tools, in one pass for this raised-and-recessed structure.

scenes.title_cn: 原理：正常情况下整个面中最膨的位置应…
scenes.title_en: Principle: normally the fullest point of t…
sentences: 正常情况下，整个面中最膨的位置应该在苹果肌这里。
Normally the fullest point of the mid-face is the apple cheeks.
fullest point（最膨点）
苹果肌往下掉堆积在鼻翼旁边，阴影就变得更深。
Dropped apple cheeks pile beside the nose and deepen the shadow.
deepened shadow（阴影变深）
不能只提亮那道线，还要把下移的高光面从视觉上让它上移。
Don't just brighten the line—visually lift the dropped highlight plane.
lift the highlight（上移高光面）
scenes.speak: Normally the fullest point of the mid-face is the apple cheeks. Dropped apple cheeks pile beside the nose and deepen the shadow. Don't just brighten the line—visually lift the dropped highlight plane.

scenes.title_cn: 手法一·提亮凹面：把头侧向45度，让…
scenes.title_en: Technique one · brighten the hollow: tilt …
sentences: 把头侧向45度，让光从半侧面打过来，就能看到法令纹的凹面。
Tilt 45 degrees so side light reveals the fold's hollow.
find the hollow（找凹面）
用比肤色亮一号的遮瑕膏，在手臂上晕一晕再上脸。
Use concealer one shade lighter, blended on the hand before applying.
blend on the hand（手背晕染）
一定不要一次性把大量粉堆在法令纹上，越拍越大。
Never pile on a lot at once—the more you spread, the worse.
build thin（少量薄层）
paraphrase: blend on the hand（手背晕染
blend on the hand（手背晕染
scenes.speak: Tilt 45 degrees so side light reveals the fold's hollow. Use concealer one shade lighter, blended on the hand before applying. Never pile on a lot at once—the more you spread, the worse.

scenes.title_cn: 手法二·拍晕与散粉：拿一个迷你粉扑对…
scenes.title_en: Technique two · tap and set: fold a mini p…
sentences: 迷你粉扑对折，用折面精准地在这个区域内拍晕。
Fold a mini puff and tap precisely in the zone.
folded puff（对折粉扑）
一次不够就沾手背上的余粉，少量多次地叠加。
If one pass isn't enough, build with leftover powder in thin layers.
thin layers（少量多次）
不要追求百分之百平整，完全平了反而僵硬像假人。
Don't chase 100% flatness—total smoothness looks stiff and doll-like.
too flat is fake（过平显假）
scenes.speak: Fold a mini puff and tap precisely in the zone. If one pass isn't enough, build with leftover powder in thin layers. Don't chase 100% flatness—total smoothness looks stiff and doll-like.

scenes.title_cn: 手法三·压凸面与重塑苹果肌：把这里下…
scenes.title_en: Technique three · flatten the bulge and re…
scenes.context: 收缩色腮红压凸+重建苹果肌。
sentences: 这个区域不需要变成暗面，只需要让它平、没那么凸出。
This zone doesn't need to go dark—just flat and less protruding.
flat, not dark（平而非暗）
换一个收缩色的腮红压在我们凸起的这个区域，画一个C。
Use a shade-narrowing blush on the bulge, sweeping a C.
the C sweep（画C）
用膨胀色腮红搭配植绒小粉扑，重塑苹果肌的凸点。
Rebuild the apple's peak with brightening blush and a velour puff.
velour puff（植绒粉扑）
scenes.speak: This zone doesn't need to go dark—just flat and less protruding. Use a shade-narrowing blush on the bulge, sweeping a C. Rebuild the apple's peak with brightening blush and a velour puff.

scenes.title_cn: 总结与边界：这三步搞完，法令纹自然地…
scenes.title_en: Summary and limits: after these three step…
scenes.context: 三步还原年轻感+结构性边界。
sentences: 这三步搞完，法令纹自然隐藏，苹果肌也饱满起来了。
After these three steps the folds hide and the apple fills back in.
the three steps（三步）
像法令纹这种结构性的凹陷，只能通过化妆改善，不可能完全消失。
Structural hollows can only be improved, never fully erased.
structural hollows（结构性凹陷）
遮了肯定要比不遮在大部分光源下好看。
Concealing beats not concealing under most lighting.
better than none（遮比不遮好）
scenes.speak: After these three steps the folds hide and the apple fills back in. Structural hollows can only be improved, never fully erased. Concealing beats not concealing under most lighting.

practice: Lift the dropped highlight plane, not just the line.
Tilt 45 degrees so side light reveals the hollow.
Blend on the hand and build in thin layers.
Use shade-narrowing blush in a C, not shadow.
Rebuild the peak with brightening blush on a velour puff.
pitfalls: Tilt 45 degrees and find the actual hollow.
Blend thin on the hand, build in layers.
Brighten the whole area at once.
Keep the brightening precise and thin.
Use shade-narrowing blush in a C instead.
Keep a natural fold—total flatness looks fake.
shifts: 用 fold（法令纹）、hollow（凹面）、backlit plane（背光面）
用 flat brush（扁头刷）、blend on the hand（手背晕染）、thin layers（少量多次）
用 shade-narrowing blush（收缩色腮红）、brightening blush（膨胀色腮红）、velour puff（植绒粉扑）
